summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private _resolve_path helper. Exported it from monai/data/__init__.py with an explicit import. Added a "Decathalon DataLoader" subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst. Added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Tests were not run and black was not run, per instructions; line lengths were checked by measurement (all under 120). Judgment calls: missing image/label fields are skipped rather than errored; a non-list value under the key raises ValueError; a non-object top-level JSON is treated as a missing key. Nothing committed.
